notes: Budget periods: group filter (AC_PASSWORD_EST_PERIOD), period number max+1 when empty (the generated list of values on PERIOD_CODE points to the empty ST_PERIODS), date checks and no overlapping periods (APP_RULES3_GL, see processes/ACESTMT_PRIODS.md)

rules.where: (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or PERIOD_CODE in (select period_code from ac_password_est_period where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE)))
